details.label: Summary
details.text: Strongest gusts are likely to continue in at least a narrow swath across east central Nebraska, and the Missouri River vicinity between Omaha and Tekamah, into the I-80 corridor of western Iowa through 4-5 AM CDT

details.label: Discussion
details.text: The most intense convection remains concentrated near a new MCV evolving from an initial supercell now approaching the Norfolk vicinity, with an intense westerly rear inflow jet in excess of 80 kt still being sampled, at least in mid-levels in recent radar imagery. Based on its current storm motion, it still appears on track to reach the Missouri River vicinity near/north of Omaha into the Tekamah vicinity by around 09Z. Although latest objective analysis suggests that the magnitude of potentially unstable inflow could gradually begin to weaken along or just north of the I-80 corridor into central Iowa, it still seems probable that activity could maintain severe strength into the Greater Des Moines vicinity by around 11-12Z
